decisions_cause_selon_decision.name: decisions_cause_selon_decision
decisions_cause_selon_decision.value: ("decisions_effacement"."decision" = 'accepter' AND "decisions_effacement"."cause" IS NULL) OR ("decisions_effacement"."decision" IN ('refuser', 'ecarter') AND "decisions_effacement"."cause" IS NOT NULL)

decisions_gel_si_litige.name: decisions_gel_si_litige
decisions_gel_si_litige.value: "decisions_effacement"."cause" IS DISTINCT FROM 'litige_en_cours' OR "decisions_effacement"."gel_id" IS NOT NULL

gels_litige_levee_complete.name: gels_litige_levee_complete
gels_litige_levee_complete.value: ("gels_litige"."levee_le" IS NULL) = ("gels_litige"."leve_par" IS NULL) AND ("gels_litige"."levee_le" IS NULL OR "gels_litige"."levee_le" >= "gels_litige"."posee_le")

visibilite_intervention_complete.name: visibilite_intervention_complete
visibilite_intervention_complete.value: ("visibilite_acces"."intervention_perimetre" IS NULL) = ("visibilite_acces"."intervention_debut" IS NULL) AND ("visibilite_acces"."intervention_debut" IS NULL) = ("visibilite_acces"."intervention_fin" IS NULL) AND ("visibilite_acces"."intervention_fin" IS NULL OR "visibilite_acces"."intervention_fin" > "visibilite_acces"."intervention_debut")

a_trancher_cloture.name: a_trancher_cloture
a_trancher_cloture.value: ("a_trancher"."etat" = 'ouvert' AND "a_trancher"."decision" IS NULL AND "a_trancher"."tranche_par" IS NULL) OR ("a_trancher"."etat" = 'tranche' AND coalesce(length(btrim("a_trancher"."decision")), 0) > 0 AND coalesce(length(btrim("a_trancher"."tranche_par")), 0) > 0)

conditions_par_defaut_validite.name: conditions_par_defaut_validite
conditions_par_defaut_validite.value: "conditions_par_defaut"."valide_du" IS NULL OR "conditions_par_defaut"."valide_au" IS NULL OR "conditions_par_defaut"."valide_au" >= "conditions_par_defaut"."valide_du"

conditions_commerciales_validite.name: conditions_commerciales_validite
conditions_commerciales_validite.value: "conditions_commerciales"."valide_du" IS NULL OR "conditions_commerciales"."valide_au" IS NULL OR "conditions_commerciales"."valide_au" >= "conditions_commerciales"."valide_du"

echeances_emission_datee.name: echeances_emission_datee
echeances_emission_datee.value: "echeances"."statut" NOT IN ('emise', 'payee') OR "echeances"."date_emission" IS NOT NULL
